steps.goal: Identify a possible route to the two matching exits and decide which visible labels to test first.

steps.goal: Test a possible route through the first narrow section while keeping Pac available to explore the other labeled area.

steps.goal: Test whether Pac can use the visible bubble and orange rescue area to advance toward the second exit.

steps.expected_feedback: The players may discover whether the visible bubble supports a top bounce or side attachment and whether the rescue area changes a route; the image alone cannot settle these behaviors.

evidence.claim: The image visibly labels Pac rescue and shows orange platforms and the matching exits beyond the second barrier.

steps.goal: Continue toward the right-side matching exits and finish with both characters.
